February in the capital is a cold spring.
Inside the inner chambers of the palace, the palace maids who came and went with joy on their faces were carrying hot water and handkerchiefs to the middle of the palace with a lively step.
Bright yellow dragon bed stretched out a white hand, a small eunuch waiting at the side of the heart scared to look at the emperor bare feet to go down to the ground, the eunuch chief Tian Fusheng is outside to warm his majesty's shoes, this will be no one to stop, the first recovery of the emperor is really going to bare feet on the ground!
The little eunuch couldn't think too much, and with a jolt he scurried over to the ground in front of the bed, and the feet of the most honorable man in the world stepped on the little eunuch's back just in time.
The little eunuch was sweating, trying his best to relax his back muscles, for fear of tensing up and making His Holiness uncomfortable, and complaining in his heart that his clothes were too rough, for fear of scratching His Holiness's feet.
The saint let out a laugh and scolded with a smile, "Get out of the way."
The little eunuch didn't dare to disobey him, but he also didn't dare to let him go down to the ground like this, and boldly said, "Your Holiness mustn't, the ground is cool, and there will be coldness seeping into the dragon's body from the soles of his feet."
As soon as Tian Fusheng came in, he heard these words from the little eunuch, and busied himself by coming forward and kneeling down on the ground, holding the dragon boots in his hands, and falsely cried, "Your Holiness, the little one will come to serve you on the ground, but don't put your feet down, the little one's heart is about to jump out of his throat."
Gu Yuanbai was dumbfounded, "I'll see that you can jump out 17 or 18 times a day."
Tian Fusheng hemmed and hawed, carefully supporting Gu Yuanbai's feet and meticulously putting on his shoes and socks.
Gu Yuanbai couldn't help but sigh in his heart as he sniffed the smoky and medicinal scent that filled the room.
He was not some serious emperor, but a positive and upwardly mobile twenty-first century promising young man, the moment he passed through the clouds while playing high altitude parachute jump, and when he opened his eyes he had already woken up in this body.
The dynasty was called Daheng, not from memory, and should have been overhead, with a level of production reaching that of the Northern Song.
Gu Yuanbai's this body is really the efforts of the country to raise out of the delicate, is too sick and weak, the emperor when there is not much strength.
When Gu Yuanbai arrived, the first signs of eunuch dictatorship had already appeared, knowing that the emergence of eunuch dictatorship often signaled that a dynasty had reached its mid-to-late stage. Powerful ministers and local power expansion, eunuchs also want to manipulate the military and government, Gu Yuanbai dragged this sick body, hibernation for three whole years, in one fell swoop will be powerful ministers and eunuchs collectively pulled down the horse, cleaned once again in the former dynasty and the inner court, temporarily balanced the power of the three sides, will be the majesty of the imperial power back to the full bloom of the time.
Just as he was ready to fist pump and do something big, his body didn't hold up, and he was greeted with a blast of wind chill at the end of winter.
Seriously ill a few days Gu Yuanbai happened to hear one or two extremely familiar names, which finally remembered, he is not crossing into a hollow world, he is wearing a book.
The young emperor in the book will not live more than a few years before he dies, giving way to the book's hero attack, the famous regent, and the book's hero subject is a capable minister who will assist the regent to leave a good name for the rest of the world.
Gu Yuanbai is a straight man, iron-straight, and knows about this book or because it was adapted into a socialist brotherhood of court politics and fighting web series.
After knowing that he could not live for a few years, Gu Yuanbai became a Buddha, and all his previous ambitions were thrown aside, not as fragrant as a duck in sauce.
This throne is not destined to be his, and any more he does now is to let the future emperor pick up the pieces.
This time in the illness, Gu Yuanbai thought a lot, and finally decided to let nature take its course, he managed his own these years, to enjoy the last period of his life on the throne, and in the meantime to play the soy sauce, and spectate the socialist brotherhood of the two male protagonists in the book.
Gu Yuanbai had never really seen such socialist brotherhood.
"Your Holiness, it's done." Tian Fusheng put down Gu Yuanbai's feet, gently afraid of hurting His Holiness.
Gu Yuanbai finally stood on the ground, and the palace maid came with smoked and scented regular clothes to change Gu Yuanbai's clothes.
Clothes have not yet been changed, outside a eunuch came to inform: "Your Holiness, the Prince of Harmony with the Minister of the Household and his son are waiting outside the temple."
"Let them in." Gu Yuanbai said.
The eunuch guided the three in, and the three saluted towards Gu Yuanbai, who faintly answered, "Rise."
The son of the Minister of the Household has not yet established the crown, it is the age of the sky is not afraid of the earth, he was his father in the morning urged a dozen or twenty times, ten thousand must not look directly at the face of the Holy Spirit, but do not let him do what he is partial to do, and now stands behind the Prince of Hepatopia and father, through the corner of the concealment, secretly lifted up the eyes.
The Lord of the Heavens, as Gu Yuanbai had said, was the most delicate person raised by the efforts of the nation.
The young gentleman raised his eyes, and saw the courtesan carefully smooth the saint's head of green silk behind him, the saint is only sick today, in order to celebrate, specially dressed in a red robe, jade face reflecting the thin red.
The young male's breath caught, his heart thumped, and he hurriedly lowered his head in panic, never daring to raise his eyes to look up again.
"This is the eldest son of Lord Tang's family?"
Gu Yuanbai's tone was kind, Lord Tang was flattered, bowed and said, "Your Holiness said to me only the previous time that there were fewer young people in the palace, and that my dog's son had mediocre qualifications and was naturally stupid, but was better than being young, and made a lot of noise on weekdays. If your majesty doesn't mind, I will let him come into the palace more often to accompany your majesty, or to relieve your majesty's boredom."
Gu Yuanbai wanted to sigh again.
Some days ago he just made a big thing, such a hint is in order to let these ministers to send their children to the palace, both as a rope to hold the ministers, but also in order to show favor, so as to knock favor a few times to split the literati bureaucratic group, three is to see if there is a talented, so as to cultivate the loyalty of their own use before it's too late.
But now, he didn't have the heart.
"Come here, let me take a good look," Gu Yuanbai beckoned towards the young male, "Lord Tang don't be self-effacing, I've heard of your reputation for teaching well."
The young son held his breath as he walked up to the saint, and Lord Tang was also nervous with his back slightly wet. Ever since His Holiness cleansed the inner sanctum in one fell swoop, he would always be nervous when facing His Holiness, and as His Holiness' majesty in the imperial court intensified, he was worried that his first son would lose his decorum in front of the royal court.
Fortunately, the Holy Spirit should be in a good mood today, the questions asked are also very amicable, the little son answered one by one, from the beginning of the stuttering also gradually let go.
Gu Yuanbai was about to pick up his cup and take a sip of tea when his hand steeply and powerlessly shook, and the teacup fell to the ground with an ear-piercing crunch. Gu Yuanbai looked at the fragments on the ground, only to feel a burst of anger attacking his heart, and with a tickle in his throat, he began to cough.
The young gentleman was startled, subconsciously looking towards the saint, the saint's white transparent fingers touching his chest, his long eyebrows slightly knitted, his previously light colored lips were now coughed up as if stained with rouge.
His Holiness has a good look with infinite spring breeze and infinite autumn moon, just like a celadon so valuable that it is unparalleled in the world, so that people don't even dare to come close to touch the magnificence of touching it.
"Your Holiness," the young male boldly reached out to support Gu Yuanbai, worriedly saying, "Are you alright?"
The broken teacups had been packed down, Gu Yuanbai stopped coughing and revealed another smile, "Good boy, I'm fine."
The Prince of Harmony, who had not spoken since entering the hall, snorted, and coolly said, "Your Holiness should take good care of your dragon body, when Father passed this world on to your Holiness, your Holiness was not as weak as he is today."
Gu Yuanbai sighed, "Prince He said yes."
Gu Yuanbai quickly adjusted his emotions as he got up and walked outside the hall, looking up at the weather, "Today's weather is really nice."
"His Holiness has recovered greatly, and the sky has cleared up," the Minister of the Household Department followed, "During the few days that His Holiness was ill, the people of the city were also worried, praying for His Holiness at home day after day. His Holiness ruled the world with virtue, the hearts of the people in the world are all smooth, and the heavens also cherish His Holiness."
The saint laughed, the minister of households saw this, and then said: "these two days should be sunny, spring rain is as expensive as oil, some days ago the rain, the grass and wildflowers in the countryside are also in full bloom. The dog son said, they have a cuju tournament tomorrow."
"Oh?" Gu Yuanbai was interested, "Cuju tournament?"
The current saint likes cuju, this is something that everyone in the world knows. The young gentleman's face was red, saluted and said, "Tomorrow is the cuju tournament that the scholars within the academy are about, collectively there are four teams of scholars, for one and a half hours."
Gu Yuanbai said, "Said I also come to some interest, your school tomorrow's Cuju tournament held in when and where? I will also go and join in the fun."
The young male's voice trembled as he answered, "Yes, yes."
Tian Fusheng sharp eyes to see the saint's brow between the exhaustion, he rushed forward to invite away the Minister of households and his son, and the Prince stood aside when all the way to the wood, at this time the face of the iron green, fiercely glared at Gu Yuanbai, flinging his sleeve together to go.
Gu Yuanbai looked at this ugly look on his face and laughed for a while, not stopping laughing until his chest was stuffy, and said in a spirited manner, "Tian Fusheng, go, follow me for a stroll through the Imperial Garden."
"Yes."
*
Tang adults father and son out of the palace in a hurry to split the road, one to find the Secretary of the Ministry of War to make preparations for tomorrow's saint out of the palace to watch the Cuju tournament, one quickly back to the school, to go with the head of the teaching that the saint's personal visit.
This matter really turned up shock waves in the National Academy, the head teacher rubbed his head and stood up, "The saint himself?"
The assistant teacher and the straight lecturer sucked in a mouthful of cold air, supported each other, and looked at the son of the Minister of the Household, Tang Mian, with great earnestness, where is there any stern reserve in the usual way.
Tang Mian was equally excited, "His Holiness said he wanted to come and watch our academy's cuju tournament."
The headmaster was of the fifth rank, and had only seen the holy face from afar, when he heard this news, a great joy surged up in his chest, and he walked around the house with a spring in his step, laughing from time to time, as excited as if he were drunk.
The assistant teachers and straight lecturers had never seen the face of the Holy Spirit, and one of them, Zhong Zhi Lecture, who was now in his fifties, could not help but shed two lines of hot tears and murmured with those around him, "I had not thought that I could also have the day to face the Holy Spirit."
The assistant teacher barely calmed down, "Master Teacher, those four cuju teams in our academy are recruited randomly, with good and bad skills, if they go on the field like this, it will surely spoil His Holiness's fun."
The head teacher's footsteps jerked to a stop, couldn't help nodding: "Right right, then today quickly re-group four teams to kick cuju kick powerful. Hahaha, that group of brats, I'm afraid to hear that the saint is coming, all swarmed up."
Remembering something, the Sect Leader turned his head again and asked Tang Mian, "Did His Holiness say whether it would be a private visit in a small way or with great fanfare?"
Tang Mian neighed: "The saint did not say so, but my father has already gone to the Minister of War."
The head teacher thought about it, stroked his beard and nodded, also no longer with the Tang Mian said more, said: "tomorrow you must go on the field, today rest well, tomorrow so that I can compete for the glory of my state school."
Tang Mian firmly said, "Student Council!"
As long as he thought about the fact that the saint would come to see him play cuju tomorrow, he already felt energized, and couldn't wait for tomorrow to be now so that the saint would know how good he was.

There are two official schools in the capital, one is the state school, the second is the Imperial College. That night, the news in the state school somehow spread to the Imperial College, the Imperial College's headmaster had the cheek to issue a unilateral invitation to cooperate, but also set up four teams of cuju team, intends to tomorrow in front of the emperor with the state school to have a good competition.
What's so fun about playing by yourselves in the academy? Bring us along! Our students are tall and strong, and they're good at soccer!
In the piece of finding pain for the state school, the Imperial College took it to death.
On the second day, His Majesty really drove, His Majesty dressed in regular clothes, sitting in a pavilion covered with a cloth, this time is still spring cold, His Majesty's side of the waiters and civil and military ministers, none of them dared to let His Majesty to blow some cold winds again.
Pavilion only to the side of the field to the empty, fire pots piled up on one side, at this time the game has not yet begun, but the side of the field has been crowded with the people who have heard of the game.
These people, they want to see His Majesty.
There was a cacophony of voices outside the arena, all topping the sky after the hustle and bustle, and there were people who climbed up into the trees, hugging the trunks and craning their necks to look into the arena.
The son of the Minister of the Household, Tang Mian, clenched his fists to the point of some numbness, he only felt his chest tighten with tension, and after glancing at the pavilion in the distance where His Holiness was staying, the tension turned into a bearish fighting spirit again.
His best friend, the Prince of Pingchang Marquis, was at that moment nervously speaking with Tang Mian, "I feel as if my calves are cramping up."
Tang Mian was shocked, "Rub it quickly, the game will start in a while, we have to play beautifully for the Emperor!"
"It's because I know that His Holiness is here that I'm nervous," Marquis Pingchang's son said with a bitter face, "My father heard that I'm going to kick a soccer ball for His Holiness today, and called me up early in the morning before dawn, juggling fists and running, and I'm exhausted to death."
Tang Mian was dumbfounded as he turned left and right worriedly, "You can't be missing when you're playing the Dragon's Tail so well."
Marquis Pingchang's son couldn't help but feel smug as he struggled to swing his leg and let out a "hiss", "I'll rub it first."
Most of the field to play cuju are not yet the crown rites of the boy, heard that the saint is coming, and now there are so many people around to see, although there is some stage fright, but excitement and excitement accounted for the majority.
"It's still a bit cold outside, but these boys aren't afraid," Gu Yuanbai was draped in a fox fur, the white fluff surrounding the side of his face, "Look at that, all wearing thin shirts."
Tian Fusheng heartbroken saint, carefully warmed a pot of tea for him, "running up sweating, just after sweating easy to get cold, in the end is young, can stand."
"Order it down, and when the kick is finished promptly send a bowl of ginger soup to the schoolhouse, so that the people will be careful not to lose a lot of money for a small reason."
"Yes." Tian Fusheng let the order go down.
*
A match between two academies was naturally eye-catching, and the sounds of applause and chagrin traveled far and wide, all the way to another mound not far away.
Chu Wei is trekking with fellow students, far away from the lively scene, fellow students laughed: "If it is not I really have little interest in Cuju, I also want to go over to make fun."
Chu Wei brow light, he is a green clothes, appearance of flowing and dashing, the instrument is elegant, between the eyebrows has a few points of alienation cold meaning, really is a jade general people, the whole capital is famous in the first beautiful man.
"Hustle," Chu Wei said, "if the top is good, the bottom will throw in the towel."
Fellow students teased, "You should be happy that today's saint is good not that strange and precious, otherwise it would be another disaster for the world's living beings."
Chu Wei not far away from the crowd of cold-eyed acquaintance, he since seven years ago after winning the examination in the Xieyuan went out to study, see the hardship and can not eat the people more and more, then more and more disappointed in the higher powers. Today's saint has no merits and faults, mediocre, let the powerful ministers in the head of the bullying for so many years, there is really nothing worth letting Chu Wei another eye place.
His fellow students knew what he was thinking just by looking at his expression, and he smiled, leisurely continuing to step on the green.
Now Daheng on the surface of the sea is calm and clear, but in the eyes of the form of insightful people, but know that this peace can not be maintained for a long time.
Once this frail and sickly little emperor died, internal and external problems, wolves around, then casually pull a Gao Yi, the spell is the hand of the soldiers and horses.
Even if the little emperor is lucky enough to survive, can he tame those hungry wolves with green eyes?
Tamed by what, by infirmity?
*
This a hot and lively cuju match, kicking people are sweating, watching people also sweating. What's more, as soon as these young boys and girls got off the field, there was a palace chamberlain sent a bowl of steaming ginger soup, and after learning that it was specially instructed by the saint, a lot of poor children from poor families couldn't help but redden their eyes.
"Thank you, Your Holiness," picked up the ginger soup and finished it in one go, the whole body even the body soon became warm, there are a few tall and big teenage boys also hid their red eyes, urning their voices, "Ginger soup is very tasty."
"A few brothers quickly go to put on the clothes," the palace chamberlain is also very kind, "in the end is still early spring, ten thousand must not be slack."
The people slowly dispersed, and after Li Yan, the son of the Marquis of Pingchang, pinched his nose and drank a bowl of ginger soup, he shouted, "Cool!"
Handing the bowl to the chamberlain, he took Tang Mian's shoulder and urged, "Brother Mian, why don't you drink? It's not because you can't bear to part with it, is it?"
Tang Mian's ears reddened, and he was busy drinking it all in one sip, "He doesn't have a door on his mouth, and he's just talking nonsense."
As the two were talking, Marquis Pingchang's boy ran over, "Shizi, His Lordship asked you to hurry over and go with him to the saint's face."
Marquis Pingchang's son froze, "Face the saint?"
He was at a loss for words, "I I I I... I'm still wearing my cuju uniform."
The boy was in a hurry and said, "Feel free to put on some clothes first, the master is in a hurry."
Marquis Pingchang's son hurriedly followed him over, and together with Marquis Pingchang, they went to the pavilion to face the saint.
Gu Yuanbai happened to have invited the head teachers of the two academies over to speak, and after receiving the briefing, he said, "Come in."
Marquis Pingchang's father and son saluted and said cautiously, "Your Majesty's dragon body is just healing, so I thought I'd come and take a look."
Gu Yuanbai smiled, "Why are you so formal with me? Sit down."
Marquis Pynchon sat meticulously not far from him, his spine straight and still tense.
How can they not be nervous? Those who don't face the saint can never know how they feel, the saint was young when he ascended to the throne, originally thought that these ten years had already let them penetrate the saint's character, who knows that all the guesses are the saint's a game, the saint is only how old? The crown was erected only last year!
As his father sat down, Marquis Pingchang's son didn't dare to sit down, Gu Yuanbai's gaze swept over to the body of this teenage son who had kept his head down and said, "This is Yan Ge'er, isn't it, and it turns out to be already this big."
Marquis Pingchang said, "The boy is stubborn, and being older is even more of a headache for me."
"Young people should be the same," Gu Yuanbai laughed, "Yan Ge'er, come sit by me."
Li Yan apprehensively sat down beside the saint, although it is beside, but also separated from the position of the two people standing, I do not know whether it is an illusion, after sitting down, Li Yan always felt that the tip of the nose smelled a trace of fragrance.
The incense used in the palace are good incense, the more you smell the more intoxicated you are, Li Yan smelled the whole body is crispy, and heard the saint on the sidelines joked: "I have heard a lot of adults have said that the Prince of Pingchang marquis handsome, but unfortunately they do not have a marriageable daughter in the family, otherwise it is necessary to make the first move."
Pingchang Hou feel very proud, Li Yan but bashful fidgety, the saint promotes very narrow, deliberately with him: "Yan brother, head up to let me also look at your appearance today."
Li Yan and head stiff duck like, violently raised his head, bashful young face also red, eyes also forgot to dodge, straight saw the holy face.
The saint looked at him with slight surprise, Li Yan stalked his neck, his chest connecting to his mind.
Marquis Pingchang drank, "Li Yan!"
Li Yan's heart jumped violently, almost the whole person also jumped up, he hastily lowered his head and said at a loss, "Your Holiness, the kid is unruly ......."
Gu Yuanbai liked such a lively, young and powerful young man, he smiled, "Marquis Pingchang, there's no need to be like this. Yan Ge'er is true to himself and is a good boy."
The saint praised a few words, Pingchang Hou let his son retreat. Li Yan's footsteps were in a trance as he exited the pavilion, Tang Mian was constantly looking outside the guards stationed there, and when he saw him come out he waved his hand hastily.
Li Yan walked over, two people look at each other, a wordless toward the crowd. Walked a few steps, Li Yan suddenly stopped his feet, he looked around, swallowed his saliva, turned his head to follow Tang Mian said: "You say, you last time into the palace is not also see the appearance of the saint?"
Tang Mian gently nodded his head, "What's the matter, you watched it this time too? Don't you listen to your father the most?"
Li Yan touched his head and smiled hehehehe, not answering this, instead he said as if he was throwing a bomb on the flat ground, "How about the two of us collaborate to find a painter? I want to paint ......" he pointed to the sky, and although he was afraid, he still boldly felt an overwhelming excitement, "paint that one."
Tang Mian jumped in place in shock, "Are you crazy?!"
"I'm not crazy," Li Yan squeezed his eyes towards him, "we are not according to the painting, eyebrows and eyes in me, nose and lips in you, want to see the painting we will meet the painting together, usually nothing to hide the painting in the bedroom, who can still find out?"
Tang Mian swallowed his saliva, his mind crossed that day in a glimpse of the appearance of the Holy Spirit, and then with Li Yan to look at each other, each other know, this is a success.

Gu Yuanbai finished drinking half a pot of tea, and the cuju tournament outside was about to end. He slowly propped up the stone table and got up, the backs of his white jade-like hands were covered in powerless pale green veins, Gu Yuanbai coughed a few times against his fists and waved away the attendant who wanted to come forward, "It's not a problem."
Marquis Pingchang looked at him worriedly, "Your Holiness, your dragon body has just healed, you must not blow the wind, you should be precious."
Gu Yuanbai hooked up his lips, although his body is sick and weak, but a smile has the vitality of a hundred flowers blooming, "ginseng, deer antler, tortoise shell, more than these, tiger bone, ganoderma lucidum, Cordyceps ...... I see that no one in the world is more precious than me."
"Marquis Pingchang, no one in the whole world is more sparing of life than I am," Gu Yuanbai said to himself, and suddenly laughed pleasantly, "Although the medicinal herbs are expensive, but I still have to say that the taste is indeed not very good, and every time I take it, I want to throw a basket of licorice into it."
The Marquis of Pingchang could not help but sigh in his heart the will of God, the saint hibernates for so many years, patience and the city is not the same as ordinary people, and so open-minded and bright, why God has to play tricks on this young son of God, have to give the saint such a body of dragging hind legs it?
He followed with a few laughs and spoke warmly with the Emperor for a few more moments.
Soon, someone came to inform which side had won and which side had lost, and Gu Yuanbai nodded as he listened, saying, "Reward."
The head of the guards took a look at the color of the sky, and took a few steps forward to persuade Gu Yuanbai to return to the palace in a low voice. The morning court of Daheng Dynasty is once every two days, today there is nothing to do before coming to see the Cuju tournament, Gu Yuanbai originally thought of turning around in the capital, under the persuasion of the idea was also eliminated, leaving a few palace guards here, was escorted by the guards on the carriage.
Marquis Pingchang respectfully sent the saint left, was about to take his son back to the house, but listened to his son with the Ministry of household Secretary of the eldest son did not know where to go, Marquis Pingchang was shocked, the anger rose up again, sullen face back to the house alone.
*
It was only when it was about to get dark that the Marquis of Pingchang's residence welcomed the world's son. Marquis Pingchang had people waiting in the front yard, and as soon as Li Yan stepped into the house, he was called into the study by his father.
"I didn't know until after His Holiness left today that you even left early as well," Marquis Pingchang said angrily, "You dared to leave first before His Holiness moved, you really have a lot of guts!"
Li Yan gulped when he heard him mention His Holiness, he was afraid of being found out, and busily said, "Father, guess what I saw today? When I was roaming the streets, I actually saw that Xue Yuan fellow galloping his horse in the downtown area, he is also really too arrogant!"
Marquis Pingchang frowned: "Arranging horses in the city? No, I have to write a folding report to the saint."
Li Yan quietly exited the study and returned to his room before he breathed a sigh of relief, he told everyone around him to get out, the door of the room was closed, the candle was a little bit, and the warm scroll in his arms was spread flat on the table.
To hide the scrolls of the Holy Spirit is a great treason, how can the Holy Face be so casually hidden in the bedroom of a small student?
Li Yan as the Marquis of Pingchang son, naturally know this truth. But he just can't control it, always feel excited excitement in the heart is very excited, straight to the face of the saint feel afraid apprehensive, but to remove the eyes from the saint, but also feel reluctant.
He didn't have any bad intentions, and he didn't intend to do anything bad with the portrait, but he just thought that His Holiness was really good-looking, and it would be a shame not to paint it.
Li Yan movements carefully, the scroll, is a very honorable man. This man's eyebrows are Li Yan mouth, painter hand painting, the following face ink is very light, this is to cover up the use, in addition to him and Tang Mian, no one can know that this painting part of the painting is the saint.
His Majesty's eyebrows have a special flavor, but the painter has not seen it with his own eyes, Li Yan looked at it for a while and said in frustration, "Still say that it is the best painting in the capital, what kind of stuff is this painting, the shape is similar to the God is not similar to the God, it is still not as good as my painting work."
Cursing for a while, he carefully put the scroll away and placed it in the dark drawer at the head of the bed. Li Yan made a trip to the couch, and his mind recalled the image of the Holy Lord meeting him today.
I don't know if this day's disrespect will make the saint dislike him, and he doesn't know what he looks like when he kicks the cuju today, he must be red in the face and thick in the neck, and the saint praised him for being handsome, and it doesn't look good to kick the cuju when he is even more handsome.
Thinking about it and thinking about it, Li Yan fell asleep in a daze.
*
Juvenile children's thoughts, Gu Yuanbai naturally do not know. He was waited on and washed and changed his clothes, and his face was a little white in the evening, and Tian Fusheng asked softly, "Smaller to press the head for His Holiness?"
On top of the bright yellow dragon couch, three beautiful palace maids dressed in thin clothes knelt beside Gu Yuanbai, silently holding a handkerchief to wipe the Emperor's wet black hair.
"No need," Gu Yuanbai closed his eyes, enduring the discomfort in his body, "Have your little disciple come over and pound my legs."
Tian Fusheng busy little apprentice to call, the little eunuch kneeling under the dragon couch, skillfully pounding the legs, the heart also can not help but beautiful, the saint likes his handiwork.
Once the dark hair was dried, the three courtesans quietly got out of bed and retreated barefoot.
"Tian Fusheng," Gu Yuanbai suddenly spoke out, his voice lazy and seemingly on the verge of falling asleep, "How's what I asked you to do done?"
Tian Fusheng: "Your Holiness, everything is going well."
"Well," Gu Yuanbai said, "the previous batch of people sent out, each one is my heart and soul, let them act with care, the news is not important, live is the most important."
"Yes, I'll go over it again tomorrow."
Gu Yuanbai three years ago in the dark sent people to adopt a group of orphans, give food to wear to live, teach them to read and recognize words and kill the enemy's skills, daily uninterrupted brainwashing education, finally became a sharp blade in the hands of Gu Yuanbai.
They only listened to the emperor's words, they would do whatever the emperor told them to do, a year ago, Gu Yuanbai had picked out four hundred of them with the highest loyalty, and had them infiltrate into the mansions of the various ministers, as well as the borders and the garrisons around the country, not only these, but also the forbidden army in the palace, and these guards around him had these people lurking within them as well.
